surface.title: Feel one steady surface.
surface.body: Rest a hand on your chair, your clothing, or the floor. Notice the texture.

look.title: Find one color nearby.
look.body: Let your eyes rest on one object. Notice a shade or an edge.

ease.title: Give your hands a rest.
ease.body: If it feels comfortable, let your fingers loosen a little.

choice.title: What would help next?
choice.body: Choose a different exercise or finish here.

see.title: Something you can see.
see.body: Look for colors, shapes, or shadows.

touch.title: Something you can touch.
touch.body: Notice the texture of clothing or a nearby surface.

smell.title: A scent you can notice.
smell.body: If nothing comes to mind, move on whenever you like.

taste.title: A taste or familiar flavor.
taste.body: You can also remember a familiar flavor.

finished.title: You can finish here.
finished.body: Take a moment to decide what you want to do next.

ownPace.title: Breathe at your own pace.
ownPace.body: Let the breath come and go comfortably. Follow the optional count only if it feels easy.

after.title: A moment for yourself.
after.body: You can take a pause before deciding what comes next.

rest.title: Take the time you need.
rest.body: Let your hands rest wherever they feel comfortable. Notice one thing around you.

worry.title: Caught in “what if”?
worry.body: Is there a practical step you want to take, or is your mind asking for certainty?

worryLater.title: Leave a little room for uncertainty.
worryLater.body: You can let the question stay unanswered for now and return to one thing in front of you.

worryAction.title: One thing you can do.
worryAction.body: Choose a small, practical action. You can use your saved step or make a new plan.
